programme.title: Night Vision
programme.desc: A psycho serial killer who videotapes each of his bloody conquests is on the loose, and it's up to alcoholic motorcycle cop Dak and his new tough-as-nails partner, Kristen, to bring him to justice. But as the body count increases, so does the danger.

programme.title: Conspiracy
programme.desc: In the not so distant future, a team of white collar criminals are enlisted by the Federal government to thwart a cyber-attack that threatens to bankrupt the United States of America.

programme.title: Warning Shot
programme.desc: Single mother Audrey (Tammy Blanchard) and her young daughter Cheyenne (Onata Aprile) attend the funeral of Audrey's grandfather. Struggling to make ends meet as a waitress, Audrey considers moving into her grandfather's old farmhouse if it is left to her in his will.

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

programme.title: Saving Lincoln
programme.desc: Director Salvador Litvak and his writing partner, Nina Davidovich Litvak, based their screenplay on their extensive research into Lincoln's friendship with Lamon. ''Saving Lincoln'' charts their relationship from their initial meeting to Lincoln's Presidency. Lamon was a tall, boisterous Southerner who liked to drink whiskey, tell jokes and stories, play the banjo, and wrestle. Despite some pronounced differences between the two men, they shared a fondness for telling jokes and stories, and both felt slavery should be eliminated. Lamon often served as Lincoln's private confidant.

programme.title: Stamm
programme.desc: Two soldiers from different sides are unified by their faith and shared humanity. During this unexpected and life changing encounter at the Battle of Belleau Wood in 1918, the men must choose between their country and their beliefs.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Young Jim Hawkins and Peg-legged Long John Silver set sail for adventure in Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale of dastardly pirates, swashbuckling heroes, buried treasure, and a young boy's courage during the adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Decembers
programme.desc: Diciembres centres on the US invasion of Panama in 1989 and a reconciliation among survivors a decade later. Ten years after the brief but brutal US military invasion of Panama on December 20th, 1989, three estranged survivors are nudged towards an intimate reconciliation by the person they lost in common that ruthless night.

programme.title: Second Acts
programme.desc: When a woman reports her daughter as missing, the Blue Heelers find she has moved in with her schoolteacher.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
programme.desc: The spoiled rotten and utterly unlikable rich kid George Amberson becomes horrified when his recently widowed mother rekindles her relationship with the wealthy Eugene Morgan, who she left decades earlier in order to marry George's father. As George struggles to sabotage his mother's new romance, he must deal with his own romantic feelings for Morgan's daughter and the consequences of his meddling as his once great family falls into ruin due to his machinations...

programme.title: One Upon a Time in Deadwood
programme.desc: A lone gunslinger with no name is poisoned by Ursula, a young woman who gives him the task of retrieving her kidnapped sister Abigale, in whose possession he'll find the antidote. The slow-acting poison gives him three days to rescue the heiress's sibling. He is forced to accompany Ursula to Deadwood, where Abigale is held by a gang of notorious criminals. She is kept in their lair, the Gem Saloon. A string of gun battles ensues.

programme.title: Slackers
programme.desc: Dave Goodman, Sam Schecter, and Jeff Davis are best friends who have spent almost four years at Holden University scamming their way through college. During one exam scam in their final semester Dave discovers Angela, and asks her out while writing his phone number on her exam sheet. Ethan Dulles (who calls himself "Cool Ethan"), a classmate obsessed with Angela to the extent of collecting loose hairs and making a hair doll and having surveillance photos and a shrine to Angela setup in his dorm room, takes her exam question sheet after Angela leaves and uses it to repeatedly confront and then blackmail the guys into setting up a successful date with Angela for him in exchange for his silence on the matter. The guys set Ethan up in multiple situations in an attempt to convince Angela to like him, while Dave tells Sam during their work researching her that Angela is no more important to him as any other scam they've done. Ethan fails to attract her after frequent confrontations based on his delusional behavior, immaturity and ignorance of social norms. Though Ethan seems a lonely harmless nerd, he is scheming, psychotically obsessive and hopelessly socially incompetent.

programme.title: Blind Obsession
programme.desc: During a gun battle with a pair of criminal brothers, police officer Jack Fletcher (Brad Johnson) incurs a wound that leaves him temporarily sightless. During his recovery, Jack is helped by Rebecca (Megan Gallagher), who works as a "trainer" for the newly blind. Gradually, Jack and Rebecca fall in love, much to the dismay of Rebecca's overprotective sister, Bedelia (Roxana Zal), who as a childhood incest victim has developed a pathological hatred for all men. Thus, once his sight is restored, Jack finds himself in the crosshairs of two potential assassins -- the demented Bedelia, and the brother of the crook he killed.

programme.title: Out of Control
programme.desc: A woman decides to steal her mobster boyfriend's car and a whole lot of his money, then tries to hide out in a small town.

programme.title: Wake of Death
programme.desc: Ben Archer (Jean Claude Van Damme), club owner and gangster from Marseille, returns to L.A. after yet another job for the mob. But, he is tired and ants to get out. He wants a normal life with his son Nicholas and wife Cynthia. Cynthia is a social worker for the INS working to prevent the organized flow of illegal Chinese immigrants into the USA. In a raid on a shipping vessel one night she finds a little girl, Kim, amongst the distraught immigrants and takes pity on her. She convinces her boss, detective Mac Hoggins, to take her home with her the night and to her Chinese adoptive parents Tommy and Mamma Li. What she doesn t know is that Kim holds a danger to Cynthia and her family. She is the daughter of Sun Quan (Simon Yam). Feared leader of the Chinese Triad.

programme.title: Spartaks
programme.desc: Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.

programme.title: Rītdienas robeža
programme.desc: Zemi iekaro citplanētu iebrucēji, un pēc piecu gadu cīņām viņi ir gandrīz iekarojuši Eiropu. Ģenerālis Brigems (Brendans Glīsons) nosūta majoru Viljamu Keidžu (Toms Krūzs) kā dezertieri uz savu jauno vienību – J vadu. Jau pirmajā kaujā Keidžu nogalina, taču viņš šokēts atmostas iepriekšējā dienā. Izmisīgos centienos izlauzties no apnicīgās laika cilpas, Keidžu sāk trenēt elites kareive Rita Vrataski (Emīlija Blanta), kura ir cilvēces pretošanās simbols. Viņas vadībā Keidžs kļūst par Zemes labāko ieroci un iespēju, kā iznīcināt citplanētu iebrucējus.

programme.title: Kā tikt pie bērna
programme.desc: Keisija (Dženifere Anistone) ir gudra un neatkarīga sieviete, kura, neskatoties uz sava labākā drauga Volija (Džeisons Beitmens) iebildumiem, nolemj vairs nogaidīt "īsto vīrieti" un tikt pie mazuļa ar spermas donora palīdzību. Mākslīgās apaugļošanas ballītes laikā neirotiskais un pamatīgi iereibušais Volijs nejauši izlej izvēlētā donora paraugu un panikā to aizstāj ar savējo, taču nākamajā rītā neko no notikušā neatceras. Pagrieziens seko pēc septiņiem gadiem, kad Keisija atgriežas Ņujorkā kopā ar savu dēlu Sebastianu — apburoši dīvainu un hipohondrisku zēnu. Satiekot bērnu, Volijam pamazām sāk atgriezties atmiņa, un viņš ar šausmām saprot, ka zēna dīvainības ir precīza viņa paša kopija. Nu Volijam ir jāatrod veids, kā pateikt patiesību savai labākajai draudzenei, pirms viņa savu dzīvi nesaista ar vīrieti, kuru visu šo laiku uzskatīja par sava bērna tēvu.

programme.title: Spartaks: Arēnas dievi
programme.desc: Viss kulminē grandiozajā jaunās arēnas atklāšanā, kur Batiāts ir spiests likt lietā visus savus resursus un intrigas, lai nodrošinātu savas skolas godu un izdzīvošanu.

programme.title: Kas skatāms Filmzone?
programme.desc: Iepazīstinām ar Filmzone filmām.

programme.title: Rītdienas robeža
programme.desc: Zemi iekaro citplanētu iebrucēji, un pēc piecu gadu cīņām viņi ir gandrīz iekarojuši Eiropu. Ģenerālis Brigems (Brendans Glīsons) nosūta majoru Viljamu Keidžu (Toms Krūzs) kā dezertieri uz savu jauno vienību – J vadu. Jau pirmajā kaujā Keidžu nogalina, taču viņš šokēts atmostas iepriekšējā dienā. Viņas vadībā Keidžs kļūst par Zemes labāko ieroci un iespēju, kā iznīcināt citplanētu iebrucējus.

programme.title: Kā tikt pie bērna
programme.desc: Keisija (Dženifere Anistone) ir gudra un neatkarīga sieviete, kura, neskatoties uz sava labākā drauga Volija (Džeisons Beitmens) iebildumiem, nolemj vairs nogaidīt "īsto vīrieti" un tikt pie mazuļa ar spermas donora palīdzību. Mākslīgās apaugļošanas ballītes laikā neirotiskais un pamatīgi iereibušais Volijs nejauši izlej izvēlētā donora paraugu un panikā to aizstāj ar savējo, taču nākamajā rītā neko no notikušā neatceras. Pagrieziens seko pēc septiņiem gadiem, kad Keisija atgriežas Ņujorkā kopā ar savu dēlu Sebastianu — apburoši dīvainu un hipohondrisku zēnu. Satiekot bērnu, Volijam pamazām sāk atgriezties atmiņa, un viņš ar šausmām saprot, ka zēna dīvainības ir precīza viņa paša kopija. Nu Volijam ir jāatrod veids, kā pateikt patiesību savai labākajai draudzenei, pirms viņa savu dzīvi nesaista ar vīrieti, kuru visu šo laiku uzskatīja par sava bērna tēvu.

programme.title: A komanda
programme.desc: Seriāls stāsta par četriem bijušajiem ASV armijas specvienības karavīriem, kuri, netaisnīgi apsūdzēti noziegumā, bēg no militārās policijas un palīdz cilvēkiem, kuri nonākuši nelaimē.

programme.title: Bēgšana no Šoušenkas
programme.desc: Filma ir par baņķieri Endiju Defrēnu, kam piespriesti divi mūža ieslodzījumi par sievas un viņas mīļākā nogalināšanu. Cietumā viņš sadraudzējas ar Elisu Boidu "Redu" Redingu, Defrēns jūtas drošībā pēc tam, kad viņa zināšanas finanšu nozarē izmanto cietuma darbinieki un ieslodzītie.

programme.title: Rītdienas robeža
programme.desc: Zemi iekaro citplanētu iebrucēji, un pēc piecu gadu cīņām viņi ir gandrīz iekarojuši Eiropu. Ģenerālis Brigems (Brendans Glīsons) nosūta majoru Viljamu Keidžu (Toms Krūzs) kā dezertieri uz savu jauno vienību – J vadu. Jau pirmajā kaujā Keidžu nogalina, taču viņš šokēts atmostas iepriekšējā dienā. Izmisīgos centienos izlauzties no apnicīgās laika cilpas, Keidžu sāk trenēt elites kareive Rita Vrataski (Emīlija Blanta), kura ir cilvēces pretošanās simbols. Viņas vadībā Keidžs kļūst par Zemes labāko ieroci un iespēju, kā iznīcināt citplanētu iebrucējus.

programme.title: A komanda
programme.desc: Seriāls stāsta par četriem bijušajiem ASV armijas specvienības karavīriem, kuri, netaisnīgi apsūdzēti noziegumā, bēg no militārās policijas un palīdz cilvēkiem, kuri nonākuši nelaimē.

programme.title: Novembra cilvēks
programme.desc: Bijušo CIP aģentu nosūta uzdevumā, kura laikā viņš atklāj, ka viņa pretinieks ir viņa bijušais students, un viss notiekošais ir bīstama spēle, kurā piedalās augsta ranga CIP amatpersonas un tikko ievēlētais Krievijas prezidents.

programme.title: Svētais Vincents
programme.desc: Pensionārs Vincents ir tālu no svētā: viņš smēķē, dzer, lamājas, spēlē azartspēles un reizi nedēļā satiekas ar prostitūtu. Vincenta neganto pusi izjūt arī vientuļā māte Megija Bronšteina, kura kopā ar divpadsmitgadīgo dēlu Oliveru ievācas blakus mājā. Tomēr strādājošajai sievietei drīz neatliek nekas cits, kā lūgt palīdzību kaimiņam. Kamēr viņa slimnīcā strādā maiņu darbu, Vincents pieskata Oliveru – protams, savā unikālā veidā. Viņš ved puiku uz krogu, ļauj piedalīties derībās hipodromā un māca viņam kauties. Tomēr Vincents ļauj Oliveram iepazīt citu viņa pusi. Viņš ņem zēnu līdzi uz pansionātu pie savas slimās sievas Sandijas, kuru viņš arvien ļoti mīl. Zēns drīz vien labāk par jebkuru citu ir iepazinis savu neparasto aizbildni un viņu iemīļojis. Tomēr, kad Olivera tēvs tiesas ceļā vēlas iegūt aizbildnības tiesības, Vincenta neskaitāmie grēki kļūst par nopietnu problēmu.

programme.title: Spartaks
programme.desc: Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.

programme.title: Tas neērtais moments

programme.title: Riska robeža
programme.desc: Trilleris, drāma, ASV, 2011. / Režisors: Džejs Si Čendors / Lomās: Kevins Speisijs, Pols Betanī, Džeremijs Aironss, Demija Mūra. 2008.gada septembris. Pasaules ekonomiskā krīze jau ir sākusies, tomēr Amerika vēl nenojauš, kāda katastrofa to sagaida. Tikai neliela grupa Volstrītas topmenedžeru meklē iespējamos glābšanas ceļus. Pasaules lielākās investīciju bankas darbinieks ar jaunākās finanšu analīzes programmas palīdzību saņem šokējošu prognozi - akcijas kritīsies, tirgus sabruks un banka zaudēs visu. Nākamajā rītā viņa štata vieta tiek likvidēta. Pametot darbu, zibatmiņu ar šokējošo informāciju viņš nodod savam bijušajam palīgam. Bankas krahs ir neizbēgams.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Doktors Vils Kasters ir vadošais pētnieks mākslīgā intelekta jomā, taču viņam ir daudz pretinieku, kuri pat gatavi viņu nonāvēt. Mirstošais zinātnieks lejupielādē savu prātu datorā un pēc nāves iegūst neierobežotu varu, par kādu nav uzdrošinājies sapņot. Drīz viņa intelekts kļūst bīstams cilvēkiem, taču pat viņa sieva un labākais draugs neredz iespēju viņu apturēt.

programme.title: Trīs paziņojumi pie Ebingas Misūri štatā
programme.desc: Mildredas Heizas meita Andžela tika izvarota un noslepkavota pirms vairāk nekā pusgada, taču slepkavības izmeklēšana nevirzās uz priekšu. Mildreda sper izmisīgu un pārdrošu soli - uz ceļa, kura malā Andžela tika atrasta, viņa uz reklāmas stendiem izvieto trīs paziņojumus, kas adresēti Ebingas pilsētiņas šerifam Viljamam Vilobijam. Policija uzskata šo par kara pieteikumu un dara visu, lai paziņojumi tiktu aizvākti. Taču Mildreda nedomā padoties, un spriedze tikai pieaug.

programme.title: Māceklis
programme.desc: Stāsts par meistaru un viņa mācekli Ņujorkas nekustamo īpašumu džungļos. 70. gadu sākumā Donalds Tramps ir iesācējs - kompleksu mākts lietu kārtotājs, kurš atrodas tēva Trampa seniora pavēnī. Iepazīstoties ar advokātu Roju Konu, viņa dzīve mainās. Pārņemot no citiem idejas, spārnotus teicienus un Kona taktiku, Tramps kļūst par savu "labāko versiju". AIDS epidēmija, šovbiznesa ziedonis un itāļu marmora modernās pilis. Pilsēta, kas nekad neguļ, ir Trampa spēļu laukums - tiesa, tajā viņam pašam kļūst par šauru. Donalda Trampa juridiskā komanda mēģināja bloķēt filmas izlaišanu, un filmas veidotājiem bija grūtības filmai ASV atrast izplatītāju tās satura dēļ, tomēr filma piedzīvoja pirmizrādi 2024. gada 77. Kannu kinofestivālā, kur tā sacentās par "Zelta palmas" zaru. Filma nominēta divām Amerikas Kinoakadēmijas balvām kategorijās "Labākais aktieris galvenajā lomā" (Sebastjans Stens) un "Labākais aktieris otrā plāna lomā" (Džeremijs Strongs).

programme.title: Ļoti labas meitenes
programme.desc: Divas Ņujorkas meitenes noslēdz paktu zaudēt nevainību pirmajā vasarā pēc vidusskolas beigšanas. Kad viņas abas iemīlas vienā un tajā pašā ielu māksliniekā, draudzeņu saikne pirmo reizi tiek pārbaudīta.

programme.title: Tolkīns
programme.desc: "Vienīgais lēmums, kas tev jāpieņem - ko darīt ar tev doto laiku," reiz sacījis slavenais rakstnieks Džons Ronalds Rūels Tolkīns, grāmatu "Hobits" un "Gredzenu pavēlnieks" autors. Biogrāfiskā filma sekos Tolkīna kļūšanai par rakstnieku un ved cauri viņa skolas gadiem, kad bez vecākiem palikušais Tolkīns atrod draudzību, mīlestību un radošo iedvesmu starp citiem skolā atstumtajiem. Diemžēl draudzības saites un Tolkīna aizraušanos ar literatūru draud sagraut Pirmais pasaules karš...

programme.title: Kinsijs
programme.desc: Alfrēds Kinsijs ir amerikāņu biologs, viens no mūsdienu seksoloģijas tēviem un arī pionieriem. Kinsija tēvs bija puritānis, un Alfrēds izauga pārliecībā, ka sekss ir nepieciešams tikai cilvēces turpināšanai. Atklājis sevī zoologa talantu, Kinsijs nonāca pie slēdziena, ka amerikāņi vispār neinteresējās par cilvēces seksualitātes problēmām. Esot īstens zinātnieks, viņš sāka iedziļināties seksualitātes vēsturē.

programme.title: Ideālā Ferdinanda Čevala pils
programme.desc: Ševals ir pastnieks, kurš katru dienu ceļo pa Dromas upes apkārtni. Viņš satiek savas dzīves īsto sievieti Filomenu, un no viņu savienības piedzimst Alise. Tad viņš metas trakā azartspēlē: savām rokām uzcelt viņai neticamu pili.

programme.title: Kliko kundze
programme.desc: Pēc vīra pāragrās nāves Barba Nikola Ponsardēna Kliko pretstatā pieņemtajām normām pārņem jaunā vīndarīšanas uzņēmuma grožus, ko abi ar vīru bija veidojuši. Vadot uzņēmumu cauri politiskām un finanšu grūtībām, viņa ignorē kritiķus un rada revolūciju šampanieša industrijā, kļūstot par vienu no pasaules pirmajām, dižajām darījumu sievietēm.

programme.title: Šokolādes miers
programme.desc: Pēc sava tēva šokolādes fabrikas uzspridzināšanas burvīgs jauns sīriešu bēglis cīnās, lai iedzīvotos savā jaunajā mazpilsētas dzīvē, iestrēdzis starp sekošanu savam sapnim un ģimenes mantojuma saglabāšanu.

programme.title: Puika A
programme.desc: Stāsts par jaunu vīrieti, kurš nupat atbrīvots no cietuma par vardarbīgu noziegumu, ko viņš pastrādājis bērnībā.

programme.title: Selena + Chef: Home For the Holidays
programme.desc: Selena Gomez welcomes Chef Alex Guarnaschelli to help her cook a feast for her tree-trimming party. While the family decorates, Selena and Alex prepare an indulgent feast with Fried Mozzarella Sticks and Creamy Marinara, Alex's whipped cream infused "Chantilly" Mashed Potatoes, Black Pepper Roast Beef and Gravy, and Chocolate Candy Cane Bark to top it off. Alex and Selena make a video call to a very special someone. Later, the gang is joined by Selena's friends and family to enjoy the spread and admire the tree.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: Award-winning actor and producer Wendell Pierce joins Ina Garten for cooking and conversation at the barn. Ina serves Raspberry Corn Muffins for breakfast and shows Wendell how to pipe them with raspberry jam. Then, Ina learns about his amazing rise to fame, incredible family history, career challenges and gritty roles on stage and screen. Wendell loves seafood, so Ina teaches him to make a delicious one-pan Summer Skillet with Clams, Sausage and Corn.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: Tina Fey joins Ina Garten for a fun-filled day of deep conversation and cooking. Ina welcomes Tina with breakfast panna cotta, and they team up to make Tina's signature Greek lemon potatoes served with Ina's chicken thighs with creamy mustard sauce.

programme.title: Holiday Wars
programme.desc: Three new teams battle it out for the last spot in this year's Holiday Wars. Inspired by the holiday film "Red One," host Jeff Mauro asks each team to create a display depicting Santa's unique workout routine. Plus, each team must have two full characters on their display and incorporate a gravity-defying element. Which two teams will move on, and which team will judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown send home?

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: It's cookie day, and Ree Drummond's baking a fantastic foursome to share with friends and family. There are awesome Chocolate Mint Iced Cookies decorated with swirls of snow white royal icing, Browned Butter Sugar Cookies that become the base for Cookie Jam Pies, next-level Chocolate Chip Cookies with Bacon and Caramel Corn, and No Bake Cookies made with grains, seeds, fruits and nuts. Ree packs them all into cute cookie collections for the kids to hand deliver to friends and family.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is reclaiming kitchen scraps and transforming them into star dishes. Peels, stems and bones destined for the trash are instead turned into crispy Roasted Potato Peels, Stir Fried Broccoli Stems and an awesome all-purpose Overnight Chicken Broth. Then she raids the fridge for leftovers to use in a frugal Crisper Crash Frittata and gives past-its-prime fruit a second chance with Leftover Fruit Bread. Ree turns pie crust scraps into four stunning treats and finally upcycles cheese scraps into the ultimate Leftover Cheese Dip.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: It's a truffle kerfuffle in the Chopped kitchen as four chefs are amped up to work with prized fungi in every round. In the appetizer round, the chefs take their dishes in four very different directions, and the judges aren't sure that everyone is making wise decisions. A pricey cut of meat in the truffle-themed entrée round puts pressure on the chefs to honor an extra extravagant basket, and the dessert round challenges the final two with crafting truffle-forward treats.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's goin' global! They're firin' up Filipino flavor in Calgary, Alberta, plating righteous rotisserie chicken and out-of-bounds island adobo. A funky food truck in Austin, Texas, is bringing elevated Egyptian BBQ to the masses, crankin' out the-bomb brisket with a turmeric-and-tahini twist, plus fully loaded lamb mac. And near Cincinnati, a Hong Kong hotspot with deep culinary roots is slingin' ginger chicken, some serious stir-fry, and mega egg rolls.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Selena + Chef: Home For the Holidays
programme.desc: Selena Gomez welcomes Chef Alex Guarnaschelli to help her cook a feast for her tree-trimming party. While the family decorates, Selena and Alex prepare an indulgent feast with Fried Mozzarella Sticks and Creamy Marinara, Alex's whipped cream infused "Chantilly" Mashed Potatoes, Black Pepper Roast Beef and Gravy, and Chocolate Candy Cane Bark to top it off. Alex and Selena make a video call to a very special someone. Later, the gang is joined by Selena's friends and family to enjoy the spread and admire the tree.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: Award-winning actor and producer Wendell Pierce joins Ina Garten for cooking and conversation at the barn. Ina serves Raspberry Corn Muffins for breakfast and shows Wendell how to pipe them with raspberry jam. Then, Ina learns about his amazing rise to fame, incredible family history, career challenges and gritty roles on stage and screen. Wendell loves seafood, so Ina teaches him to make a delicious one-pan Summer Skillet with Clams, Sausage and Corn.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: Tina Fey joins Ina Garten for a fun-filled day of deep conversation and cooking. Ina welcomes Tina with breakfast panna cotta, and they team up to make Tina's signature Greek lemon potatoes served with Ina's chicken thighs with creamy mustard sauce.

programme.title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown
programme.desc: In the season finale, the final three teams are squaring up in an epic showdown. It's nearing the time for the Scout Elves to head back to the North Pole to help Santa prepare for Christmas Eve. As they return home, they will fly over their favorite places on Earth, so host Duff Goldman challenges the sweetmakers to "elf-ify" a famous landmark in their honor. In the end, judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt crown their Ambassadors of Confectionery Concoctions and award them $25,000!

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: Sun's out, grills out! Michael Symon soaks up the summertime weather and fires up his grill to encourage everyone to get cooking out with his easy and crowd-pleasing outdoor dinners. From sticky ribs to desserts, Michael shares his grilling tips and tricks to make every meal flamingly delicious. Self-shot from his New York backyard, cook along with Michael as he works live fire to show how simple and fun it is to make amazing dishes on the outdoor grill.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is cooking mega with big food for the big game. Then she makes over-the-top Monster Meatballs, a Super-Sized Slice of Pizza using her Foolproof Pizza Dough for her football-mad son and a mammoth Mile High Mud Pie that's perfect game-watching grub.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is making divine chocolate treats for her daughter, Paige, to share with her school friends, and she's sneaking in a few for her husband, Ladd, while she's at it. There are adorable Classic Chocolate Cups decorated with homemade Sugared Orange Peels and a bunch of store-bought toppings. Ree shows her love with over-the-top Love and Kisses Cookies and the easiest Chipotle Fudge, and double-dipped Cookies and Cream Marshmallow Treats are made with oodles of chocolate and lots of fun.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

Each chef hails from a different state, but they all share the same culinary specialty and drive to beat Alex for ultimate bragging rights and $15,000.

programme.title: Alex Vs America
programme.desc: Three talented chefs representing some of the busiest sports stadiums in the United States join host Eric Adjepong and challenge Alex Guarnaschelli in a battle for the best game day dish. In round one, the chefs seal their fate by choosing the ingredients everyone will be using and hope their decision will give them the advantage. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: The Russian octopus: how the Kremlin influences the World
programme.desc: How does the aggressor, despite an international search and massive sanctions, manage to maintain influence in Europe, bypass restrictions, and manipulate Western opinion through its own propaganda? A special investigation reveals a network of Kremlin mechanisms — from the work of sanctioned "cultural centers" in Berlin and Paris to the use of the Russian Orthodox Church, Cossack organizations, and radical political parties as instruments of hybrid warfare. Analyzing the experience of Denmark, Germany, France, and other EU countries, the project demonstrates how Russia skillfully puts pressure on the "pain points" of democratic society, turning culture, religion, and political lobbying into dangerous weapons against the civilized world.

programme.title: Strāvas karš
programme.desc: Dramatisks sāncensības stāsts par elektrības atklāšanas laikmeta titāniem Tomasu Edisonu un Džordžu Vestinghausu, lai noskaidrotu, kura izgudrotā elektriskā sistēma būs noteicošā modernizētajā pasaulē.

programme.title: Deviņas lodes
programme.desc: Burlesku dejotāja riskē ar visu, lai glābtu mazu zēnu, kura ģimeni nogalinājis viņas bijušais draugs. Meitene apņemas aizvest traģēdijā izdzīvojušo zēnu sveiku un veselu pie tēvoča Dienviddakotā. Nežēlīgais noziedznieks negrasās atstāt vienīgo liecinieku dzīvu un nosūta bandītus abus medīt.

programme.title: Adaptācija
programme.desc: Pazīstams dramaturgs Čārlijs Kaufmans (Nikolass Keidžs) saņem pasūtījumu uzrakstīt filmas scenāriju pēc grāmatas "Orhideju zaglis" motīviem. Tajā žurnāliste Sūzena Orleāna (Merila Strīpa) apraksta avantūristu Džonu Laroču, kas ir tiesāts par īpašu orhideju zādzību no rezervāta. Nespēdams izdomāt scenārijam adekvātu sižeta noslēgumu Čārlijs piekrīt dvīņubrāļa piedāvājumam izsekot žurnālisti. Izrādās, ka grāmatā aprakstītie notikumi ievērojami atšķiras no realitātes un ziedu zagšanai ir pavisam citi iemesli. Sūzena izrādās iesaistījusies avantūrista Laroča dzīvē vairāk nekā parasta vērotāja no malas.

programme.title: Tuksneša bērns
programme.desc: 14 gadus vecā Suna sarakstījusi un veiksmīgi publicējusi stāstu, ko viņai mēdza stāstīt vectēvs – neticamo stāstu par Hadaru, bērnu savvaļā, kuru izglāba strausu bars un uzaudzināja tuksnesī starp savvaļas dzīvniekiem, ieskaitot viņa labāko draugu, burvīgo tuksneša lapsu.

programme.title: Tintina piedzīvojumi: Vienradža noslēpums
programme.desc: Stīvena Spīlberga triloģijas pirmā filma par slaveno Tintinu, zēnu - reportieri.

programme.title: Mēs nopirkām zvērudārzu
programme.desc: Patiess stāsts par Bendžaminu Mī un viņa ģimeni, kuri izmantoja visus savus ietaupījumus, lai nopirktu izputinātu zvērudārzu. Ar raibas komandas palīdzību un cīnoties ar dažādām nebūšanām, ģimene dara visu, lai atjaunotu zvērudārzu un atkal atvērtu to apmeklētājiem.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Reiz uz kādas paradīzes salas dzīvoja putni, kas nemācēja lidot. Tāpēc viņi visi bija labi, miermīlīgi un laimīgi... Precīzāk, gandrīz visi. Uz pārējo salas iemītnieku fona depresīvais Reds, trauksmainais Čaks un neveiklais Bumba izcēlās ar savu neparedzamo uzvedību un skaitījās izstumtie. Taču, kad salā pēkšņi parādījās noslēpumainās zaļās cūkas, kam noteikti aiz ādas bija kāda cūcība, tieši Reds, Čaks un Bumba stājās viņiem pretī!

programme.title: Minioni
programme.desc: Minjoni, kas attīstījās no dzelteniem vienšūnas organismiem, dzīvo uz Zemes kopš aizvēsturiskiem laikiem. Viņu dzīves jēga ir kalpošana, taču mazie radījumi nemitīgi atrod sev nekam nederīgus saimniekus, sākot no dinozaura un beidzot ar Napoleonu. Ja minjoniem nav saimnieka, kuram zemoties, viņi ieslīgst dziļā depresijā. Taču minjonam Kevinam ir plāns – kopā ar draugiem Stjuartu un Bobu viņš dodas meklēt jaunu ļauno saimnieku, kuram sekot. Tā viņi atrod Skārletu Nomušītu, kas ir pasaulē pirmā superļaundare.

programme.title: Viens pats mājās
programme.desc: Baksteru ģimene pārceļas uz dzīvi citā štatā, taču 10 gadus veco Finnu biedē jaunā māja, jo viņš uzskata, ka tajā spokojas. Kamēr puisēns izliek slazdus, lai notvertu "spoku", viņa vecāki aizkavējas citā pilsētas malā un viņš paliek mājās kopā ar māsu. Tikmēr trīs zagļi vēlas iegūt ārkārtīgi dārgu gleznu, kuru bijušais īpašnieks paslēpis slepenā telpā. Vai viņiem izdosies iegūt kāroto un uzvarēt kaujā ar mazo gudrinieku?

programme.title: Mīluļi apvienojas
programme.desc: Klusā, bet ļoti mūsdienīgā pilsētā Robo notiek kas neredzēts un nedzirdēts. Mērs Frenks ir zaudējis prātu. Viņa plāns neiekļaujas nekādos rāmjos. Tikai paklausieties! Viņam apnikuši cilvēki un dzīvnieki, tāpēc viņš savā prātā perina plānu - visus iedzīvotājus un mājdzīvniekus izdzīt no pilsētas un viņu mājas atdot robotiem! Kad suns bez pajumtes Rodžers uzzina šo jaunumu, viņam visas spalvas saceļas stāvus. Šis Robins Huds daudz laika pavadījis uz ielas, nočiepis dažu labu gardas desas luņķi, lai to atdotu vājākiem dzīvniekiem, un nu jūt, ka mēra plāns pie laba gala nenovedīs. No pilsētas pazudīs dzīvība! Atgriezies no jaukas pastaigas kopā ar daiļo Siāmas kaķenīti Bellu, Rodžers šausmās sastingst. Roboti sagrāvuši viņa vienīgo būdiņu! Mukdams ko nagi nes, Rodžers piepeši satiek labsirdīgo robotu Bobu, kuram mēra nodoms šķiet briesmīgs. Ir jārīkojas! Jāglābjas pašiem un jāglābj citi. Ja nekas netiks darīts, greznā mājdzīvnieku viesnīca būs briesmās. Nekā ļauna nenojauzdami, tajā mitinās daudzi četrkājainie.

programme.title: Mans kaimiņš Totoro
programme.desc: Kad smagi saslimst māte, māsas pārceļas uz dzīvi laukos, lai atrastos tuvāk mammai. Piedzīvojumā iesaistās brīnumaini meža gari, kuri arī apdzīvo tuvējo apkaimi.

programme.title: Ceļojošā Pils
programme.desc: Kad Sofija tiek pārvērsta par sirmgalvi, viņa bēg no pilsētas un atrod patvērumu Houla maģiskajā pilī. Starp lidojošām pilsētām un kara draudiem viņa atklāj mīlestību un drosmi. Studijas "Ghibli" šedevrs ir sirsnīga un burvīga pasaka.

programme.title: Gariem līdzi
programme.desc: Kad Čihiro vecāki tiek pārvērsti cūkās, viņa spiesta strādāt pirtī, kuru vada ragana. Starp gariem un brīnumainām būtnēm viņa atrod drosmi un labestību. "Ghibli" šedevrs apbur ar emocijām.

programme.title: Mirušie nesāpina
programme.desc: Divi pionieri Amerikas pilsoņu kara laikā frontē cīnās par savu dzīvību un mīlestību.

programme.title: Modiljāni. Trīs dienas uz neprāta spārniem
programme.desc: Pirmā pasaules kara laikā Parīzē bohēmiskais mākslinieks Modiljāni cenšas izvairīties no bumbām, policistiem, draudzenēm un kritiķiem, pieaugošā izmisumā meklējot mājas savai mākslai.

programme.title: Cūka
programme.desc: Robam (Nikolass Keidžs) ir īpašs talants - viņš ir izcils šefpavārs un reiz viņš priecēja savus turīgos klientus ar lieliskiem ēdieniem. Taču, kad nomira viņa sieva, Roba dzīve sabruka. Viņš beidza karjeru un pārcēlās uz nomaļu meža namiņu. Par Roba vienīgo kompanjonu nu kļuvusi trifeļu cūka, ar kuru kopā viņš pelna iztiku - līdz pēkšņi viņa četrkājainā draudzene tiek nozagta. Lai viņu atgūtu, Robs ir gatavs doties kaut līdz pasaules malai.

programme.title: Īstas sāpes
programme.desc: Tik ļoti atšķirīgie un sen netikušies brālēni Deivids un Bendžijs atkal apvienojas ceļojumā uz Poliju, lai godinātu savu mirušo vecmāmiņu. Viņu piedzīvojums uzņem jaunus apgriezienus, kad neparastā pārīša seno dienu neatrisinātās pretrunas un sarežģītās attiecības atdzimst uz ģimenes vēstures fona.

programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: Blū, Pērle un viņu trīs bērni dzīvo mājas idillē burvīgajā Riodežaneiro pilsētā. Kad Pērle nolemj, ka bērniem jāmācās dzīvot īstu putnu dzīvi, viņa uzstāj, ka ģimenei jādodas uz Amazoni. Blū, cenšoties sadraudzēties ar jaunajiem kaimiņiem, baidās zaudēt Pērli un bērnus, kuri ļaujas savvaļas dzīves aicinājumam.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Nelidojošie dusmīgie putni joprojām karo ar viltīgajām zaļajām cūkām. Viņi ir ļaunākie ienaidnieki, un, šķiet, nekas nespēs to mainīt. Taču, kad pie apvāršņa parādās jaunas briesmas, kas apdraud viņus visus, putniem un cūkām nāksies apvienoties, lai glābtu savas mājas.

programme.title: Snūpijs un Čārlijs Brauns: Riekstiņu filma
programme.desc: Čarlijs Brauns, Snūpijs un visi pārējie atgriežas ar šo aizkustinošo stāstu. Kad apkārtnē uz dzīvi apmetas jauna sarkanmataina meitene, Čārlijs Brauns viņā iemīlas. Viņš vairākkārt mēģina pievērst jaunās meitenes uzmanību un dažādos veidos mēģina savā dzīvē kaut ko sasniegt, taču katru reizi šķiet, ka neveicas arvien vairāk. Vai viņam izdosies iepatikties savai mīlestībai? Tajā pašā laikā Snūpijs apņemas tikt galā ar savu ļaunāko ienaidnieku - Sarkano Baronu.

programme.title: Kā pieradināt pūķi
programme.desc: Skarbajā Berkas salā vikingi un pūķi ir bijuši ienaidnieki paaudžu paaudzēs. Šeit dzīvo Hikaps - jaunietis ar izgudrotāja spējām, varenā vikinga Lielā Stoika dēls. Hikaps pārkāpj gadsimtiem ilgas tradīcijas, sadraudzējoties ar Nezobu - mītiem apvīto Tumsas pūķi. Viņu neticamā draudzība atklās pūķu patieso dabu un pavērs ceļu jaunai ērai pūķu un vikingu pasaulē.

programme.title: Spēka balāde
programme.desc: Kad Riks, kāzu dziedātājs, kurš jau sen ir pāri savam karjeras zenītam, kādā pasākumā satiek izbijušu zvaigzni Deniju, viņi satuvinās, daloties mūzikā un nakts vidus improvizācijās. Taču, kad Denijs pārvērš vienu no Rika dziesmām par hitu, kas atdzīvina viņa karjeru, Riks nolemj nopelnīt atzinību, ko, viņaprāt, ir pelnījis - pat ja tas nozīmē riskēt ar visu, kas viņam ir svarīgs.

programme.title: Cietais rieksts
programme.desc: Pirmo reizi Džons Makleins nonāk svešā teritorijā, kad ierodas Maskavā palīdzēt savam ietiepīgajam dēlam Džekam, nezinot, ka patiesībā dēls ir lieliski sagatavots CIP darbinieks, kuram jāaptur kodolieroču zādzība. Cīnoties ar krievu noziedzniekiem un cenšoties novērst kara sākumu, abi Makleini atklāj, ka viņu atšķirīgās darba metodes padara viņus par neapturamiem varoņiem.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Olimpia Milano - Zalgiris Kaunas
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programme.desc: Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show. David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Aman and Kevin are native Rhode Islanders living in Narragansett. They have grown tired of renting and are ready to move more centrally within the Ocean State to access their family, work and favorite activities. Conveniently located within the heart of Rhode Island, Warwick boasts 39 miles of coastline and eight beaches while providing easy access to city life in Providence or seaside life in Narragansett. Will this couple find their first home on New England waters, all for under $215,000?

programme.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: Rivaling the famous Area 51 in Nevada for UFO sightings and paramormal activity, is the lesser known, but equally fascinating, Uinta Basin in Utah and, in particular, Skinwalker Ranch. For the first time, a team of scientists and experts have been granted unlimited access to the infamous and secretive 512-acre property in order to unlock the mysteries of more than 200 years of UFO activity, bizarre animal mutations and preternatural phenomena. Making good use of state-of-the-art tecnology such as drone thermography, ground-penetrating radar and lasers, the team apply their knowledge and expertise to make shocking discoveries.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: Ancient Aliens: Origins
programme.desc: The Great Pyramid of Giza remains one of the most captivating mysteries of the ancient world, with compelling evidence suggesting it may have functioned as an ancient power plant. Could these enigmatic structures hold the key to unraveling the truth about humanity's extraterrestrial past?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: The past does not give up its secrets easily. Brand-new machines are helping explorers reveal mysteries once thought lost forever. Underwater archaeologists are searching for a World War II Nazi sub that disappeared in U.S waters. In Scotland, researchers are digging up an ancient rock, covered with cryptic markings, that could reveal more about who built Stonehenge. On this episode: German Submarine U-576; Cochno Stone; LIDAR.

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Ancient commandos fought deep behind enemy lines in some of the harshest terrains know to man. The show examines such exploits through storms and snowdrifts, revealing the tech and truth behind the world earliest known ski commandos. A journey to the deserts of Egypt reveals how a tiny army beat off a major invasion force using deception and a bunch of farm animals. The Bayeux tapestry is featured as well as one of the ancient worlds most feared and successful commando units, the Naftun.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, the stars of History's "The Curse of Oak Island," learn of a new mystery that may even rival Oak Island's. Michigan native Kevin Dykstra is obsessed with a deathbed confession made by a lighthouse keeper in the 1890s about a national treasure dating back to the Civil War. The story goes that Union soldiers tracked down Confederate president Jefferson Davis in 1865 and confiscated his gold. The stolen loot was smuggled north some years later but ended up in Lake Michigan, where Dykstra believes it still remains. His quest to prove it ultimately takes him and his team to the bottom of Lake Michigan.

programme.title: Serial Killer Earth
programme.desc: In recent years the destructive power of natural disasters has been recorded, from Hurricane Katrina to the earthquake and tsunami that devastated Japan. Serial Killer Earth brings together a top team of experts to examine the most compelling footage from news and home video, as well as eyewitness testimony, in order to explain, understand and inform viewers of what actually happened during these disasters and how they compare and contrast with the most historic natural disasters of the past.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: What would happen to planet earth if the human race were to suddenly disappear forever? Would ecosystems thrive? What remnants of our industrialized world would survive? What would crumble fastest? From the ruins of ancient civilizations to present day cities devastated by natural disasters, history gives us clues to these questions and many more in the visually stunning and thought-provoking special "Life After People."

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: In 79 AD, the volcano Vesuvius exploded in one of history's deadliest eruptions, burying the city of Pompeii and other Roman towns along the Bay of Naples beneath layers of ash and pumice. Pompeii was rediscovered in the 18th century, but only recently have archaeologists and volcanologists come to understand exactly how the eruption unfolded, and why it took the people of Pompeii almost entirely by surprise. Intrigued, host Josh Bernstein visits the Bay of Naples, and learns the entire area is built on ancient volcanic rock, some of it still steaming. He climbs the world's most active volcano--Stromboli--an island near Sicily, where ""fireworks"" from the mountain are a nightly entertainment. Back at Pompeii, he searches for clues that might have enlightened the Romans to the growing threat in their midst. And he literally plays with fire as he follows the story right into the heart of Vesuvius.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: In 1975, Travis Walton claims to have been abducted and taken aboard a space ship inhabited by extraterrestrial beings. Several people witnessed his encounter and nearly 40 years later Walton's story of alien abduction, missing time and mind-telepathy manipulation has not wavered. But researchers say that abductions are not a modern phenomenon. The Hebrew Bible is filled with stories of abductions by otherworldly beings. Jonah, Moses, Ezekiel and Enoch all depict what can best be described as physically being taken to other dimensions and then returned. Is it possible that extraterrestrial beings have been abducting humans for thousands of years and if so, might there be an alien agenda behind the phenomena?

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: River Hunters
programme.desc: In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. Spanning each river's layered past, the new series will offer a fresh perspective and even redefine our history as we know it. Using state-of-the-art technology, archive maps and contemporaneous accounts from the period, Beau and Rick perform the first underwater archeological digs in some of the most exciting and iconic historical sites in Britain, often in dangerous and fast-flowing water.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Of all the rulers mentioned in the Bible, King Solomon was purportedly the wisest...and the richest! The reason? His access to vast quantities of gold. According to the Bible, the source of his legendary wealth was the goldmines located in the mysterious land of Ophir. Yet, what the Scriptures can't tell us is where Ophir might be found today. Host Josh Bernstein leads us on an epic 4,000-mile journey in search of the lost gold of King Solomon--sailing across the Red Sea, plunging down a Zimbabwean gold mine, and traveling deep into the Ethiopian Bush.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

programme.title: When Big Things Go Wrong
programme.desc: Modern technology allows us to build incredible structures like giant tankers, mammoth skyscrapers and colossal bridges. But, with enormous size comes enormous risk, and when big things go wrong, they go really wrong. The HISTORY Channel's new series examines the catastrophic result of some of the world's worst engineering disasters caught on tape. Each episode breaks down shocking footage from collapses and collisions to reveal the shocking answers to the question, what happened? Woven together through innovative graphics, eyewitness accounts and expert knowledge, the series unravels the mystery behind these destructive moments and their lasting worldwide impact.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: On this episode, a massive explosion rocks a small Texas town killing 15 residents. A bridge in Washington collapses sending cars plunging into the river. Two construction cranes in New York City seem to fall from the sky leaving a path of destruction. A ferry full of passenger's encounters trouble and sinks. And a building demolition In Philadelphia goes horribly wrong killing innocent shoppers next door. What do all of these catastrophes have in common? They were caused by engineering failures that led to disasters of epic proportions.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.desc: In the American Southwest, there is no more puzzling mystery than the magnificent stone cliff dwellings of Mesa Verde. Why did the Anasazi Indians suddenly move their villages to these perilous cliffs in the 13th century--and then abandon them just decades later--and seemingly disappear from history? Was it drought? Invading tribes? Or an insidious ""cancer"" from within that may have caused them to turn to fierce warfare and even cannibalism? In search of answers, our host, the intrepid explorer and survival expert Josh Bernstein, travels from Mesa Verde, Colorado to remote canyons in Utah where the Anasazi took refuge. Piecing together the story from both archaeologists and Native Americans, he finally ends up, in his search for the truth, in the eerie and desolate ruins of the Anasazi's greatest cultural center--Chaco Canyon.

programme.title: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: As opposed to its sister series ''See No Evil,'' which details unlawful activity rooted out with the aid of surveillance cameras, ''Hear No Evil'' uses authentic audio recorded at crime scenes to build each episode's narrative. The result is a series that ultimately lets viewers' imaginations and instinctive fears of the unknown come to the fore.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. programme.title: The Real Murders on Elm Street
programme.desc: Investigators respond to calls of an attack on a man in front of a house on Elm Street and discover a bloody quadruple homicide. Detectives soon discover there is more to these murders than meets the eye - involving torture, revenge, and even Satan.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Crime documentary series that examines homicide investigations using unfiltered footage, including body-cam, surveillance and interrogation-room footage, giving viewers a chance to follow a case from beginning to end. The series will give viewers a chance to experience how homicide cases are conducted, from the initial crime scene investigations by body cam, to home security tapes, to interrogation room footage of real confessions. Real tapes of the investigations will be combined with interviews with friends, family members, and law enforcement directly involved in the case.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door
programme.desc: True crime documentary series. In these close-knitted communities, horrific murders have occurred, shaking them to the core. programme.title: Murder Decoded

programme.title: American Detective with Lt. Joe Kenda

programme.title: Breaking Homicide
programme.desc: The most tragic crimes are the ones that never reached a conclusion, lives have been lost and no one ever held accountable as the case eventually goes cold. Police Detective Derrick Levasseur and Forensic Psychologist Kris Mohandiewill are on a mission to reopen cases and find answers for the victims and loved ones who need to finally feel peace. They'll be looking into cases such as Michelle O'Keefe and Devan Schmidt murders, re-examining old clues and sourcing new ones, will they be able to find details that have previously been missed?

Armed with this knowledge, they are able to plan the perfect murder, hide their tracks and nearly get away with murder.

programme.title: Real Time Crime

programme.title: Border Control Poland
programme.desc: The shocking, emotional, and surprising real-life action that takes place at Poland's border crossings. The security and customs services reveal how they deal with the most bizarre and dangerous situations to keep Poland safe.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: A ranch hand, Czech immigrant Jerry Palensky, disappeared in December 2003 and was found dead in January 2004 in the Jordan River near Salt Lake City, Utah. Homicide investigators across two states worked together to catch the killer. The process of searching for the perpetrator uncovered a trail of fraud, deception and adultery, shocking the small town of Elko, Nevada. In the end, Linda Fields and her husband John Vernon Fields were convicted of the murder. The motive was a $300,000 life-insurance policy on Palensky that Linda Fields had purchased and named herself as beneficiary. In 2007, both John Fields and Linda Fields were sentenced to life in prison with no possibility of parole.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: March 16, 2020, Chatworth, Georgia: The day after his homicide, fishermen find a 27-year-old man, Kenneth Eugene Bunn, shot to death on a river embankment near the Conasauga River bridge on Carlton Petty Road in Murray County, Georgia. A key suspect in the murder investigation, Nadya Swartz, leaves homicide investigators searching for answers and evidence to piece the timeline of events together. However, jailhouse calls which are incriminating eventually reveal the truth of a twisted love triangle that ended in a brutal murder. In the end, in March 2021, both Nadya Catherine Swartz of Crandall, Georgia (the mastermind) and Justin Payton Hooker of Dalton Georgia (the gunman), both age 21, take plea deals. They are both convicted and sentenced to life in prison with the possibility of parole after 30 years in confinement for the murder of Kenny Bunn.

programme.title: Killer Confessions: Case Files Of A Texas Ranger
programme.desc: When 28-year-old mother Samantha McNorton vanishes without a trace in Wise County, Texas, police hit a dead end until Ranger Jim Holland steps in and launches a 24-hour whirlwind investigation, determined to uncover the truth.

programme.title: A Body in the Basement
programme.desc: Youngstown, Ohio, 2017; Shannon Graves, age 28, went missing under mysterious circumstances. Months later, her partially dissected remains were discovered stuffed into a chest freezer in the basement of a rental home. Who put her there, and why did they store the freezer in someone else's basement? Why was she murdered so cruelly and discarded so heinously? In the end, the three culprits responsible for her disappearance and murder were Shannon's former boyfriend, Arturo Novoa, Arturo's current girlfriend, Katrina Layton, and Arturo's friend, Andrew Herrmann. Novoa, Layton and Herrmann were all arrested and convicted of various crimes regarding the death of Shannon Graves. They were all sentenced to varying amounts of time in prison.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Crime documentary series that examines homicide investigations using unfiltered footage, including body-cam, surveillance and interrogation-room footage, giving viewers a chance to follow a case from beginning to end. The series will give viewers a chance to experience how homicide cases are conducted, from the initial crime scene investigations by body cam, to home security tapes, to interrogation room footage of real confessions. Real tapes of the investigations will be combined with interviews with friends, family members, and law enforcement directly involved in the case.

programme.title: Toxic
programme.desc: When a teenage girl in a tightly controlled religious community falls prey to her charismatic pastor, she's told it is love. Years later, she realises it is abuse and takes on those in the church who would rather destroy her than face the truth.

programme.title: No One Can Hear You Scream
programme.desc: A massacre in Gitchie Manitou State Preserve leaves four teenagers dead, and police baffled. But a witness comes forward with an incredible tale of murder and survival that could solve one of the most gruesome crimes in the history of the Midwest.

programme.title: A Body in the Basement
programme.desc: In the fall of 2003 in Hammond, Indiana, a string of disappearances leads detectives to a seemingly ordinary trophy shop worker, and a horrific discovery in his basement reveals him to be a sadistic serial killer who has been preying on the town's teens.

programme.title: Lethally Blonde
programme.desc: When detectives respond to a 911 call from a lavish Miami apartment, they uncover a bloody scene with a wildly successful social media influencer at the centre. As they attempt to piece events together, it's clear a lot is going on behind closed doors.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: If you looked into the eyes of a killer, would you know? In American Monster, you find out. For the first time, viewers get closer than ever to some of America's most shocking and surprising crimes. Filled with never-before-seen footage of these devils in disguise, from home movie shots of them playing with their kids to musical performances at high school, from the church cook-out to the wedding video, American Monster interweaves twisting-turning stories of astonishing crimes, with 'behind-the-scenes' footage of killers at their seemingly most innocent.

programme.title: Still A Mystery
programme.desc: STORY 1. Oakley Carlson, age 4, disappeared from Grays Harbor, Washington in February 2021. No one can find her, including her foster parents and her biological parents, Andrew Carlson and Jordan Bowers, who are currently under investigation for having told falsehoods to law enforcement that were debunked. Oakley had spent about three years with a foster family, Erik and Jamie Jo Hiles, before she was legally returned to her parents, Carlson and Bowers. STORY 2. March 31, 2018, Wheat Ridge, Colorado: A young mother, Jennifer Myers, born December 17, 1986 and now age 31, leaves a bar with a much older man, age 65, that she doesn't know and ends up dead in his house from a shotgun wound to her head. The main suspect, Randy Allen William, born on August 9, 1953, is the only suspect. There are many inconsistencies in this suspected murder case, but the Wheat Ridge Police Department rules this case a suicide. Jennifer's family is baffled and wants answers to their questions, such as: If the death was truly a suicide, why was the shotgun that killed her found outside by a fence on Randy William's property? Why was Randy William shown on a surveillance camera carrying two rifle cases out of his house before he called 911? Since Randy William was a former paramedic, why did he offer Jennifer no help? The family has many more questions they would like answered.

programme.title: Still A Mystery
programme.desc: Just because a case is closed doesn't mean the truth has been revealed. Suicide or murder? Runaway or kidnapping? Accidental or premeditated? Each episode of STILL A MYSTERY re-examines a single crime case where unanswered questions still remain. Through original interviews with law enforcement, family members and private investigators, news footage and social media, STILL A MYSTERY dissects the evidence and presents new theories in a quest to uncover the truth.

programme.title: High Speed Chase
programme.desc: In Ohio, a stolen white van leads police on a dangerous high speed chase as it crosses county lines. Eventually. The driver calls 911 and police soon discover that he is not alone in the vehicle. And in Illinois, a convicted felon leads police on a pursuit while riding a motorcycle. He seeks to evade capture once again.

programme.title: High Speed Chase
programme.desc: In Texas, the driver an 18 wheeler leads cops on an extremely dangerous chase lasting more than 2 hours spanning over 3 counties and multiple agencies getting involved. And after stabbing a doctor in Florida, a man sparks a dangerous interstate chase.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: I'd Kill for You
programme.desc: Tales of soured romances are explored in this true-crime documentary series, where loved ones turn against each other, leading to fatal consequences. Fraught with jealousy, betrayal, infidelity and anger, each episode focusses on a respective murder, brought to life with dramatic reconstructions and interviews with law enforcement and those with connections to the case. The series examines the incomprehensible outcomes of failing relationships, with emotionally charged partners taking the marital expression, till death do us part, far too literally.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders
programme.desc: Perry, New York. 2016. At the cookie factory, friendships rise fast—but so do rivalries. What starts as harmless gossip between co-workers soon turns sour, and when jealousy and ambition boil over, the sweet life at the plant ends in cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders
programme.desc: In a small Midwest town, three women bond over their love of Wicca and witchcraft. However, when one of them becomes convinced that a more powerful witch has placed a curse on them, she vows to break the spell - by killing the one who supposedly cast it.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Across the Deep South, heat, humidity and darn good hiding places provide a perfect backdrop for dark, despicable deeds. Southern Fried Homicide transports viewers into the steamy, Southern subculture whose lifestyles and charming drawls are captivating viewers - and covering up crimes. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE probes the juiciest stories from down in the Bible Belt, from the Carolinas to Louisiana and Tennessee. The premiere episode on June 5 at 10/9C profiles an old adage in the south: families are a bit like fudge - mostly sweet, but with a few nuts. After pedigreed Southern belle Susie Newsom's marriage fails, sweet Susie spirals and starts to have an affair...with her disturbed first cousin. When the rest of the family isn't exactly thrilled with the kissing cousins, their scandalous relationship ends with nine family members dead, spanning from Kentucky to North Carolina. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE proves that ugliness lurks behind Southern beauty when cracks in moral society give way to cold-blooded murder. Actress Shanna Forrestall, a native belle of Louisiana, serves as the gatekeeper to these salacious stories that give another meaning to things that "go south."

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror
programme.desc: Jack is accompanied by his mother Sharon Osbourne to the Glen Tavern Inn, a century-old hotel in Santa Paula, California that has a colorful but tragic past. While Sharon enters the investigation unsure about whether or not she believes in ghosts, the more time she and Jack spend at the Inn, the more she is convinced something dark is lurking in the hotel's historic suites. As the investigation's energy grows things take a dramatic turn. Sharon lands in the crosshairs of one of the Inn's most volatile entities, an angry and oppressive male spirit known for overtaking female guests – ending in a still unexplained medical mystery.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror
programme.desc: Jack and his good friend Jenny McCarthy head to the Tinker Swiss Cottage in Rockford, Illinois. Recent construction at the museum has upset the ghosts of the Tinker family, leading to aggressive activity. Can Jack, and Jenny soothe these restless souls?

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.
